senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.1.7 Bhasma भस्म
Calcinated minerals, metals or marine products
The ashes of minerals or metals obtained by calcination or incineration.

ITA-7.2.1.8 bhasmaparīkṣā ः vāritara, rekhāpurṇatā,, niścandra, niruttha, apunarbhava ] भस्मपरीक्षा [वारितर, रे खापूर्णता, निश्चन्द्र, निरुत्थ, अपुनर्भव]
Testing of calcinated minerals
An assay of calcinated minerals based on the following criteria: verifying microfine nature by flotation on water (varitara), filling in the flexor creases of the hand (rekhapurnata), non-lustrous nature (nischandra) and non-reversal to metallic state (niruttha, apunarbhava).
